scope: Playwright against the dev or preview server with model=none except the sorcerer round-trip check. Landmarks are driven through their DOM labels, so the suite runs against the stand-in or the environment workflow's renderer. Controller input is a mocked standard Gamepad API, not physical controller validation. WebGL is software-rendered (SwiftShader); no frame timing is implied.
checks: Home → My Legacy by keyboard opens the 3D Legacy screen (no modal, environment: stand-in); Legacy code loads lazily on entry; top nav hidden; sorcerer and particles suspend; Escape returns Home with the My Legacy tile focused and the hidden screen goes dormant (content-visibility: hidden)
Home → My Legacy by mouse; the always-visible Return to Home control goes back with Home focus restored

Keyboard-only founding: arrows choose Solforiz, the typed name is validated (invalid name blocked), heraldry cycles live in 2D and 3D, the motto is typed, the review step states what is saved and Raise founds directly (no repeated confirmation), the banner-raising beat plays and the found-banner event is saved

The banner, nation, heraldry and motto persist across a reload; re-entry opens the Bannerhold overview with four landmark labels and a Next step strip (Name your Pawn at the Muster Grounds) with a direct jump
Overview: arrow keys select landmarks spatially, Q/E cycle them and Home/End jump to the first/last, with the selection and focus visible
Each landmark opens a contextual inspection panel (Banner Hall, Muster Grounds, War Record, Herald's Station); E cycles panels and Back returns focus to the landmark label

Banner Hall shows identity, heraldry and blazon, nation, Minor Banner rank, recognition (a plain number), hall development and the honest empty honours state; its focused primary action is the next step toward a match, and the dissolve control sits behind a closed Manage banner disclosure

Muster Grounds: the 16-piece formation leads the panel and its pawn row is the file choice (claimed files carry the holder's mark and refuse nomination); member rows and the representative card show each person's origin; Nominate is the focused primary action, the nomination is saved, the formation shows one piece of your banner, and focus then moves to the next step (answer the challenge); Inspect frames the representative

War Record: no fabricated conflicts (honest empty state), unresolved matters (without a repeated kind label) and the ledger come from saved data (founding and nomination entries); it opens on the next step toward the match

Herald's Station: summons and the formal challenge with stance chips beside the seals, no repeated sender line, and the wager as its four stated terms at body size; read marks are saved; accepting confirms the wager again and shows the truthful Awaiting the board state
Back unwinds dialog → inspection → overview → Home and restores Home focus

Dissolve banner (inside Manage banner, the shared label on both platforms) asks for confirmation with the shared wording (defaulting to Keep), then dissolves the saved banner and restarts the founding ceremony

?legacyPreview=captive shows the persistent preview label and title, at most two aftermath messages with the War Record note (Back sets them aside), the captive state, and makes no storage writes even after interaction
Acknowledge (Enter/A) dismisses the aftermath in the session state; preview acknowledgements are still never written
An unknown preview id explains itself, lists the real development previews and touches no storage

?legacy=fresh starts a labelled guest founding that ignores and never writes the stored banner; accepting the challenge before a Pawn is named states the readiness gap and offers Name your Pawn at the Muster Grounds, which opens the Muster Grounds on Nominate
A corrupt save opens the recovery panel and stays untouched (guest or abandoned founding); Raise a new banner asks for confirmation and only the new banner's first save replaces it
A save from a newer schema is refused with its own explanation and left untouched
Controller-only founding: D-pad and A choose a nation, Suggest supplies the name, D-pad cycles the arms and A raises the banner
Controller in the Bannerhold: D-pad selects landmarks, RB cycles, A opens and RB switches panels, B closes, the right stick nudges the orbit (labels re-project), B returns Home with focus

Founding steps, overview (with the next-step strip clear of every landmark label) and all four panels fit the stage at 844×390, 1280×720 and 1920×1080 with no horizontal overflow or clipped text, no Legacy text below 11 px, and an opaque founding actions bar
With the supplied sorcerer GLB, a Home ↔ Legacy round trip keeps the same decoded model and canvas (paused and hidden while covered) and never downloads it again
Remapped keyboard bindings (WASD, F, Backspace, Z/C, PageUp/PageDown) open My Legacy, move and cycle landmarks, open and cycle panels and unwind Back to Home

Adaptive quality (stand-in frame pacing: intervals between back-to-back frames while dragging; simulated 1.5 ms per draw call): sustained slow frames step High down to Medium once after the grace period (22 s here), the player is told once, and the saved preset is untouched

A blocked Legacy screen chunk shows the honest My Legacy could not open state inside the Legacy layer (Retry focused); Return to Home restores Home with focus, the Play tab and its Classic card still work, re-entering retries the download, Escape leaves the failure for Home, and re-entering after recovery opens the founding ceremony

Retry (Enter on the focused button) re-imports the Legacy chunk under a fresh URL once the network recovers (browsers keep failed module fetches) and opens the founding ceremony; its Return to Home label matches the shared one

Launch timing recorded with and without a saved banner (8 launches, menu only and full boot): no Legacy code is requested and the Legacy save is never read before My Legacy opens; launch to first move is reported as not measurable while the Play cards are previews

Actions back to Play counted from founding, the overview, each inspector, a dialog and the aftermath: pointer worst 2 (the footer Play route; a dialog is closed first), keyboard worst 5 (Escape chain)
The web chess app's entry graph (web/src/main.tsx, 48 modules, static and dynamic imports) contains no Legacy module
No JavaScript or console errors
